Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd., established in the heart of Baroda, Gujarat, India, is a distinguished entity in the chemical industry, renowned for its commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability. Situated at 102 Sudhan Apartment, Opp Tejas School Race Course, Baroda-7, the company's strategic location places it amidst one of India's most industrially vibrant regions, enabling it to serve both local and international markets with remarkable efficiency.

Founded on the principles of scientific excellence and customer satisfaction, Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. has been consistently delivering high-performance chemical solutions tailored to meet the diverse needs of its clients. The company's portfolio spans a wide array of chemicals, with a particular focus on acids and specialized chemical compounds, which cater to various industries such as pharmaceuticals, textiles, agriculture, and manufacturing, among others.

Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. is not just a chemical supplier; it is a solutions provider. The company's state-of-the-art facilities adhere to stringent quality control measures, ensuring the production and distribution of chemicals that meet international standards. The team at Minol is composed of highly skilled professionals who are dedicated to research and development, continually pushing the boundaries of chemical innovation to provide cutting-edge solutions.

Moreover, Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. is deeply committed to environmental stewardship. The company employs eco-friendly practices in its operations, aiming to minimize its environmental footprint while maximizing its positive impact on the community. This holistic approach has earned Minol a reputation for reliability, integrity, and excellence in the chemical industry.

With a customer-centric approach, unwavering commitment to quality, and a forward-thinking vision, Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. continues to be a trusted partner for businesses seeking top-tier chemical solutions. The company's journey is a testament to its dedication to fostering growth and innovation in the chemical sector, both in India and globally.
